# vidIQ MCP

> Official vidIQ MCP plugin for YouTube creators. Bring live YouTube analytics, keyword research,
> outlier and trending videos, competitor channels, comments, transcripts, title and thumbnail scoring,
> and Instagram and TikTok short-form research into ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub
> Copilot, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw, with 14 guided creator workflows.

The service endpoint is https://mcp.vidiq.com/mcp and uses browser-based vidIQ authorization in
compatible clients. This repository contains public plugin manifests, connection metadata, and
workflow guidance for the hosted service.

## Get started

- [Product](https://vidiq.com/mcp/): Official vidIQ MCP product page
- [Setup and usage guide](https://support.vidiq.com/en/articles/15082430-vidiq-mcp): Connection, credits, and troubleshooting
- [ChatGPT plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_69dd11f3e50c8191b1ca48d03cf7e2ad): Official vidIQ listing
- [Claude connector](https://claude.com/connectors/vidiq): Official vidIQ listing in the Claude directory
- [Claude.ai connection](README.md#claudeai): Custom connector setup
- [Support](https://support.vidiq.com/): Account and hosted-service support

## Workflow skills

- [Get Started](skills/vidiq-get-started/SKILL.md): Connect vidIQ, check channels and credits, troubleshoot, recover jobs
- [Next Video Planner](skills/vidiq-next-video-planner/SKILL.md): Decide what to publish next from channel data and demand
- [Video Ideas](skills/vidiq-video-ideas/SKILL.md): Video ideas from outlier videos in the niche and adjacent niches
- [YouTube SEO](skills/vidiq-youtube-seo/SKILL.md): Keyword research, search demand, tags, descriptions, title angles
- [Trend Radar](skills/vidiq-trend-radar/SKILL.md): Which trends are urgent, durable, mature, or misleading
- [Competitor Watchlist](skills/vidiq-competitor-watchlist/SKILL.md): Find competitors and manage the tracked list
- [Channel Audit](skills/vidiq-channel-audit/SKILL.md): 30-, 60-, or 90-day channel analytics review
- [New Upload Review](skills/vidiq-new-upload-review/SKILL.md): Triage a fresh upload against the channel's curve
- [Retention Analysis](skills/vidiq-retention-analysis/SKILL.md): Where and why viewers drop off
- [Comment Insights](skills/vidiq-comment-insights/SKILL.md): What viewers ask and want, with identities removed
- [Video Breakdown](skills/vidiq-video-breakdown/SKILL.md): Analyze any public video's performance, packaging, and hooks
- [Packaging Studio](skills/vidiq-packaging-studio/SKILL.md): Write, score, compare, and improve titles, thumbnails, and scripts
- [Video Metadata](skills/vidiq-video-metadata/SKILL.md): Apply an approved title, description, tags, schedule, or thumbnail change
- [Shorts Inspiration](skills/vidiq-shorts-inspiration/SKILL.md): YouTube Shorts ideas from Instagram Reels and TikTok

## Hosted tools

Keyword research, YouTube search, trending videos, outliers, similar videos and channels, channel
stats and growth, video stats and title or thumbnail change history, transcripts, comments and
niche-wide comment insights, earnings estimates, audience retention and channel analytics, own-video
listing, title and thumbnail scoring and generation, scripts, chapters, comment reply drafts,
competitor tracking, bookmarks, approved updates to owned videos, media
production (clips, uploads, b-roll, compose, music, voiceover, video), and Instagram and TikTok
research and publishing. See [Tools the workflows use](README.md#tools-the-workflows-use).
